errors.text_span: This pie chart visualizes the distribution of categories within the FineWeb-Edu Classifier clustering results.
errors.evidence: The figure contains TWO pie charts side by side: 'AttentionInfluence' (left) and 'FineWeb-Edu Classifier' (right). The description only mentions one chart (FineWeb-Edu Classifier) and completely ignores the AttentionInfluence chart.
The description completely omits the 'AttentionInfluence' chart on the left side of the figure, which is a major part of the image.
The Education slice is green (teal/dark green), not yellow. The reference confirms it is green.
Teaching & resources is part of the Education (green) outer category, not teal as a distinct color. The inner Education slice is the main teal/green segment.
In the FineWeb-Edu Classifier chart, Health & Medicine shows 19%, not approximately 22%. The 22% value belongs to the AttentionInfluence chart. Also, the color is blue/light blue, not pink.
In the FineWeb-Edu Classifier chart, Society & culture is labeled as 5, not approximately 10%. The 10% value belongs to the AttentionInfluence chart.
In the FineWeb-Edu Classifier chart, Events & people is labeled as 2. The range '2-6%' is inaccurate; 6 belongs to the AttentionInfluence chart.
In the FineWeb-Edu Classifier chart, Infor tech is labeled as 3. The range '3-5%' is inaccurate; 5 belongs to the AttentionInfluence chart.

The FineWeb-Edu Classifier chart does not show a 'Fin & Law' or 'Fin & Engineer' slice. This category appears only in the AttentionInfluence chart. The description is mixing up content from two different charts.

In the FineWeb-Edu Classifier chart, there is no 'Policy' slice. Policy (1%) appears only in the AttentionInfluence chart. The description is incorrectly attributing elements from the left chart to the right chart.
In the FineWeb-Edu Classifier chart, Tech & Engineering is labeled as 8. The upper range of '12%' belongs to the AttentionInfluence chart value.

The FineWeb-Edu Classifier chart has fewer slices (approximately 15 outer + 5-6 inner = ~20-21 total), but the description is mixing content from both charts. The reference indicates 6 inner + 15 outer = 21 slices for each chart individually, but the count appears off given the mixed content.

In the FineWeb-Edu Classifier chart, Manage is labeled as 1 only. The '2%' belongs to AttentionInfluence. Also, the color description 'grey' is inaccurate; it appears blue/teal matching the Fin & Law category.
In the FineWeb-Edu Classifier chart, Historical review is labeled as 12. The lower value of 7 belongs to AttentionInfluence chart.
The description fails to mention that this is a nested/donut pie chart with both inner (main categories) and outer (sub-categories) rings, which is a key structural feature of both charts.
Science & technology education is part of the green/teal Education section, not cyan. The color assignment is inaccurate.
